title: Implementar runner CI del cold-start/cache STT en navegador
mission: Implement a deterministic GitHub Actions/Playwright browser runner for the deployed /pages/voice/ STT surface using only synthetic or non-private audio. The runner should make the existing cold-start versus cached-load verification executable in CI, measure bounded status/timing through model-ready/transcription or exact failure, and persist artifacts without claiming offline-first behavior or product promotion.
definition_of_done: Add a representative JavaScript-browser test for the deployed /pages/voice/ surface and its transcriber worker.
Use synthetic or non-private audio only; persist no private speech or transcript content.
Capture bounded cold first-load and cached repeat-load timing/status through model-ready/transcription completion or exact failure.
Record external CDN/model dependency behavior and whether a warmed cache permits repeat use without inferring unsupported offline-first guarantees.
Wire the test into a bounded GitHub Actions workflow or compatible existing browser-verification workflow and persist machine-readable evidence/artifacts.
Do not change Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or production /w authority.
